findings.description: D6 makes HTTP lanes refuse any packet with tools_overflow:true, but PLAN_REVIEW packets for real changes in this repo routinely overflow: the round-1 packet for this very change is 320000/320000 chars with tools_overflow:true (branch diff vs origin/main spans ~420 files). In cloud, the OpenRouter lane would therefore return packet_requires_tools on round 1 of most reviews and the run parks capability_unavailable, so Acceptance Outcome 1 (quorum 2 in cloud) holds only for the small fixture used as evidence.
findings.resolution: Specify how an HTTP lane gets a non-overflowing packet: e.g. for review_type=plan, scope the packet diff to openspec/changes/<id>/ plus spec deltas (or build a dedicated tool-less packet under its own budget), refusing only if that still overflows. Add a scenario where the full branch diff overflows but the HTTP lane still receives a packet that fits, and require the D9 evidence run to use a change whose full diff overflows.

findings.description: OpenAICompatAdapter.dispatch only calls CliVendorAdapter._parse_findings. The CLI ingest path also runs coerce_findings_payload, schema validation, stamp_judgment_ingest, line resolution, placeholder rejection and the empty_findings_too_fast floor. No task brings the HTTP lane onto that pipeline, yet the spec scenario 'Fast empty HTTP review does not count' and Acceptance Outcome 4 (findings conform to the schema and are synthesized like CLI lanes) depend on it. The traceability table maps Tool-less Lane Packet Refusal only to 1.5 and 3.8. Without judgment stamping, OpenRouter findings default to evidence_class=deterministic and count as blocking while CLI-lane findings do not, which skews consensus.
findings.resolution: Add a group-1 task with tests first: route adapter output through the shared ingest (factor the helper out of the CLI path) covering coercion, schema rejection (error_class unknown), judgment stamping, placeholder rejection and the empty-findings floor. Update the traceability rows for Tool-less Lane Packet Refusal and Metered Review Lane Spend Accounting.

findings.description: The mid-run mapping fires when 'every failed lane's error_class is UNAVAILABLE or AUTH'. A verified lane can also produce no ReviewResult at all: it is filtered at dispatch by the family or fill rule, not discovered in the worker environment, or dispatch_and_wait returns [] when job_count == 0. In that case the failed set is empty, the condition is vacuously true, and converge() returns capability_unavailable with missing_lanes == [].
findings.resolution: Define missing lanes as verified_lanes minus the lanes with a successful result. A verified lane that produced no result counts as unavailable and is named in missing_lanes. Make the same change in the skill-workflow Honest Review Quorum text and add a scenario.

findings.description: The D9 evidence gate and the 'Cloud Single-Vendor Policy Retirement' requirement both require two lanes attributed in consensus-plan.json. The converge()/agent_lane path that autopilot PLAN_REVIEW must use never writes consensus-plan.json; only /parallel-review-plan does. converge() writes .review-cache/round-N/findings-<vendor>-plan.json plus the index, and agent_lane writes result.json without the consensus. As written, the evidence cannot be produced from the mandated path.
findings.resolution: Either base the evidence on the round checkpoint index (both lane ids) plus a quorum_received value that agent_lane persists in result.json, or make task 5.5 write the consensus to reviews/consensus-plan.json. Update design D9, the retirement spec, and tasks 7.2 and 7.3 to match.

findings.description: D1 gives openrouter-review location: cloud. In routing.yaml the only tier carrying endpoint_kind openrouter is metered-api with location: local, so RoutingPolicy.cost_tier('cloud', 'openrouter') returns None, and select_model excludes the candidate (model_routing/api.py around lines 577-600). The new agent becomes an inconsistent roster entry for the coordinator router.
findings.resolution: Either use location: local, which matches the metered-api tier, or add a cloud metered tier to routing.yaml (in scope for group 2). Alternatively, state that the lane is review-dispatcher-only and add a 2.3 test showing the routing projection and select_model tolerate it.

findings.description: discover_reviewers makes a single pass over sorted(all_vendors), so the 'roster order' that D5 relies on is not available. The D2 family rule and the D5 fill rule both depend on tier-1/2 selections, which can include vendors that sort after 'openrouter' (e.g. 'pi'). Implemented inside the existing loop, both rules would read an incomplete selection.
findings.resolution: Specify a two-pass selection in D2/D5: first select CLI/SDK lanes, then apply the family and fill rules to tier-2.5 candidates in agents.yaml order. Add a 3.1/3.3 test with a non-metered vendor that sorts after the metered lane.

findings.description: D4 checks the budget only in the probe, which the supervisor runs once per batch against a $1.00 reservation. A dispatched child can then run up to 3 rounds in each of 3 review phases with packets of roughly 80k tokens, and every concurrently dispatched child sees the same remaining budget. When the coordinator ceiling is the only source (key limit null), nothing stops an overrun, so 'bounded before dispatch' does not hold.
findings.resolution: Either re-check the budget (coordinator usage and/or GET /key, both zero-cost) before each metered dispatch in CompositeOrchestrator, returning vendor_unavailable when exhausted, or require a key credit limit as the hard backstop and document the coordinator ceiling as advisory. Add a scenario for exhaustion between rounds.

findings.description: D1 says the agent has 'no cli and no sdk block, the same shape as ocr-local', but ocr-local declares a cli block (agents.yaml around lines 452-468).
findings.resolution: Drop the comparison or point to an agent that is genuinely endpoint-only.

findings.description: agent_lane.run_converge does not copy ConvergenceResult.missing_lanes into result.json. Task 6.4 expects the worker to park capability_unavailable with missing_lanes, but no task adds that field (or per-lane cost) to result.json.
findings.resolution: In task 5.5, add missing_lanes, lanes and the metered_spend_unrecorded signal to result.json, with a test.
